title: Ember Wyrm
rules:
Flying, haste.

When Ember Wyrm enters the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target.
flavor: The sky burns where it passes.

title: Frostbite Colossus
rules:
Vigilance.

Whenever Frostbite Colossus attacks, tap target creature an opponent controls.

title: Void Pilgrim
rules:
Flying.

When Void Pilgrim dies, draw a card.

title: Gilded Sentinel
rules:
Defender, reach.

Gilded Sentinel gets +0/+2 as long as you control an artifact.

title: Ashfall Ritual
rules: Deal 3 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.

title: Starless Oracle
rules: When Starless Oracle enters the battlefield, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one into your hand and the rest on the bottom in any order.
flavor: She reads the gaps between the stars.
